test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is correct for the bracketed letters with respect to their inclusion in the given series.

F, U, 17, H, O, 13, J, I, 11, (L), E, 7, N, (A), 5

options.text: The first bracketed letter is correct and the second bracketed letter is incorrect.
The first bracketed letter is incorrect and the second bracketed letter is correct.
Both the bracketed letters are correct.
Both the bracketed letters are incorrect.

solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The given series is

F, U, 17, H, O, 13, J, I, 11, (L), E, 7, N, (A), 5

The pattern follows here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8511949844e78914f402b70cbc8ae27103d354cc6295beb266a45c06cfd844.png] 

U, O, I, E, A are the vowels and 17, 13, 11, 7, and 5 are consecutive prime numbers.

Hence, **Both the bracketed letters are correct.**
